quote: Customers could not log in to both products with one account until month nine, roughly five months later than the plan.
Engineers who were paid their full retention award on day one were mostly gone by the first anniversary.
Porting the loan book onto our servicing platform overran by three months because field definitions differed.
The acquired product could not be sold to hospital customers until it passed our HIPAA controls audit, which took four extra months.
Founders who left in the first quarter took key customer relationships with them.
Nobody could say who had the final call on the warehouse system choice, so the decision dragged on for a quarter.
Annual vesting of retention shares kept the dispatch managers in place.
